questions.passage:
Birds in migratory condition can gain a tremendous amount of muscle tissue without exercise.

(A) After they have eaten as much as they can, their digestive organs shrink dramatically because these won't be put to use during the non-stop flight.
(B) Before some bar-tailed godwits leave Alaska, they undergo binge feeding. They eat until they double their weight.
(C) By the time they take off, their heart and flight muscles may have increased by 50%.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] 제시문: 운동 없이 근육 증가. (B) 출발 전 폭식→체중 2배. (C) 이륙 시 근육 50% 증가. (A) 다 먹은 후 소화기관 수축. 시간순: 폭식→근육증가→기관수축.
det.correct: ① (A)-(B)-(C): 수축이 먼저→부자연스러움 ❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): 논리 어색 ❌ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): 폭식→근육증가→수축, 자연스러운 시간순 ✅ ④ (B)-(A)-(C): 수축→근육증가 순서 어색 ❌ ⑤ (C)-(A)-(B): before 문맥 충돌 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 순서 배열: 시간 단서 Before→By the time→After. undergo≈experience. binge feeding: 폭식. 연결어: before(전), by the time(~할 때까지), after(후)

questions.passage: ① The Yellow Sea mudflats between Korea and China are some of the largest tidal mudflats on the earth. ② They provide a critical stopover point for countless migratory birds on the East Asian-Australasian Flyway. ③ The Yellow Sea is also known for its abundant seafood industry, attracting fishing boats from neighboring countries. ④ While these enormous stretches of tidal mud look featureless to the human eye, they have plenty of marine life forms. ⑤ Many birds fly several thousand kilometers to get to the Yellow Sea, where they must double their weight in less than two weeks.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계없는 문장을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] 글의 주제: 황해 갯벌의 철새 기착지 역할. ③ 수산업과 어선→철새 보호와 무관한 경제적 내용.
det.correct: ① 갯벌 규모 소개 → 주제 도입 ✅ ② 철새 기착지 → 핵심 ✅ ③ 수산업+어선 → 철새 주제와 무관 ❌ ④ 해양 생물 풍부 → 먹이원 연결 ✅ ⑤ 체중 증가 필요 → 기착지 중요성 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 무관 문장: 중심 소재(철새+갯벌)와 동떨어진 내용(수산업) 찾기. tidal mudflats: 갯벌. stopover≈layover. abundant≈plentiful↔scarce

questions.passage: They do this again and again for 25 to 30 years, flying up to 30,000 km every year. By the time bar-tailed godwits die, they have flown close to twice the distance from Earth to the moon.
questions.stem:
다음 문장이 본문과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"Bar-tailed godwits fly up to 30,000 km every year and, over their lifetime, cover roughly twice the distance from Earth to the moon."

det.ref: [원문] flying up to 30,000 km every year / flown close to twice the distance from Earth to the moon [해석] 매년 최대 30,000km / 일생 동안 지구-달 거리의 약 2배. 제시문과 일치.
det.correct: T: 매년 30,000km + 지구-달 2배 → 원문 일치 ✅ F: 불일치 부분 없음 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 TF: 숫자(30,000km, twice)와 핵심 표현(every year, lifetime) 정확 대조. close to≈roughly≈approximately. up to: 최대~까지

questions.passage: After they have eaten as much as they possibly can, their digestive organs shrink dramatically because these won't be put to use during the non-stop flight to New Zealand.
questions.stem:

det.ref: [원문] digestive organs shrink dramatically [해석] 소화 기관이 극적으로 수축한다. digest→digestive(형용사), organ→organs(복수), shrink 그대로 사용.
det.correct: 모범답안: digestive organs shrink dramatically. digest→digestive(형용사 파생), organ→organs(복수), shrink 동사 활용. dramatically는 선택적.
det.tip: 🔑 digest(동사)→digestive(형용사). shrink-shrank-shrunk. dramatically≈drastically,significantly. organ: 기관,장기
